name: Ceasing Operations
summary: Morin Cloudstalker calls on you to stop the shredder before it fells another tree. He asks you to gather allies, return to the mine in the northeast, and stop it from cutting more trees.

sections.title: A Threat to Home
sections.body: One of Fizsprocket's pages speaks of a shredder, and Morin has seen such machines on his travels. They can bring down a forest far faster than axes and muscle. Groves that sheltered the children of the Earth Mother for ages can vanish in days. Morin will not let that happen so close to where the young ones take their first steps. Bring the Clearcutter Key back to him outside Bloodhoof Village.

faq.q: What is Morin asking me to do?
faq.answer: Morin asks you to gather allies, return to the mine in the northeast, and stop the shredder from felling more trees.

faq.q: Why is the shredder a threat?
faq.answer: Morin says shredders can cut down a forest far faster than axes and muscle. They can destroy groves that sheltered the children of the Earth Mother.

faq.q: Where does Morin want me to go?
faq.answer: Morin asks you to return to the mine in the northeast.

faq.q: What do I bring back to Morin?
faq.answer: Bring the Clearcutter Key to Morin Cloudstalker outside Bloodhoof Village.
Morin Cloudstalker asks you to stop the shredder from cutting trees near the tauren home.

angles.text: As a tauren, you share Morin's concern for the groves that sheltered the children of the Earth Mother and for the safety of the young near home.
